subject.title: refactor(qa): remove execution and Matrix profiles

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally remove the private Matrix `--profile` and reusable-workflow input/output contracts now, with no compatibility fallback for retained internal callers?
rationale: The implementation and supplied proof support the new catalog-derived design, but removing callable workflow and CLI surfaces is an explicit compatibility choice that automated review should not make on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Approve profile-free QA design
options.body: Accept the documented internal-contract removal and land the catalog-derived Matrix selector before the stacked Telegram PR.

options.title: Keep a short transition path
options.body: Retain documented aliases or workflow inputs temporarily if maintainers know of supported callers that still depend on profile dispatch.

recommendation.title: Approve profile-free QA design
recommendation.body: Accept the documented internal-contract removal and land the catalog-derived Matrix selector before the stacked Telegram PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history connects this contributor directly to the proposed QA architecture and its workflow contract changes.
